claims: Tiger Woods has won 15 professional major championships.
Tiger Woods ranks second all-time behind Jack Nicklaus in professional major championships.
Tiger Woods's victories span from the 1997 Masters to the 2019 Masters.
Tiger Woods has won five Masters.
Tiger Woods has won four PGA Championships.
Tiger Woods has won three U.S. Opens.
Tiger Woods has won three Open Championships.
Tiger Woods achieved the "Tiger Slam" in 2000-2001.
Tiger Woods held all four major titles simultaneously in 2000-2001.
Tiger Woods won the 1997 Masters Tournament.
Tiger Woods won the 1999 PGA Championship.
Tiger Woods won the 2000 U.S. Open.
Tiger Woods won the 2000 Open Championship.
Tiger Woods won the 2000 PGA Championship.
Tiger Woods won the 2001 Masters Tournament.
Tiger Woods won the 2002 Masters Tournament.
Tiger Woods won the 2002 U.S. Open.
Tiger Woods won the 2005 Masters Tournament.
Tiger Woods won the 2005 Open Championship.
Tiger Woods won the 2006 Open Championship.
Tiger Woods won the 2006 PGA Championship.
Tiger Woods won the 2007 PGA Championship.
Tiger Woods won the 2008 U.S. Open.
Tiger Woods won the 2019 Masters Tournament.
Jack Nicklaus has 18 total professional major wins.
Tiger Woods became the only player to win four consecutive professional majors in 2000-2001.
The four consecutive professional majors Tiger Woods won in 2000-2001 were the 2000 U.S. Open, 2000 Open Championship, 2000 PGA Championship, and 2001 Masters.
Tiger Woods won his first Masters in 1997 at age 21.
Tiger Woods's 1997 Masters win was by a record 12 strokes.
Tiger Woods is 14–1 in majors when holding at least a share of the lead going into the final round.
